models.trains:
SELECT 
    t.id AS train_id,
    t.direction,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.direction = 'east' AND COALESCE(tr.car_count, 0) < 4 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(tr.long_car_count, 0) > 2 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_more_than_2_long_cars,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw.cars c 
                     WHERE c.train_id = t.id 
                     AND c.position = 3 
                     AND c.sides = 'double') 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw.cars c 
                     WHERE c.train_id = t.id 
                     AND c.position = 1 
                     AND c.shape = 'rectangle') 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.roof = 'none' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS number_of_open_roof_car
FROM raw.train t
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        train_id,
        COUNT(*) AS car_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN len = 'long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_car_count
    FROM raw.cars
    GROUP BY train_id
) tr ON tr.train_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN raw.cars c ON c.train_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.direction, tr.car_count, tr.long_car_count
ORDER BY t.id
